content.value: A flexible shaft consists of a 0.20 in diameter steel wire encased in a stationary tube that fits closely enough to impose a frictional torque of 0.5 lb.in/in. Determine the maximum length of the shaft if the shearing stress is not to exceed 20 ksi. What will be the angular deformation of one end relative to the other end? $\mathrm { G } { = } 1 2 \times 1 0 ^ { 6 } \mathrm { p s i }$
